layout.arrangement: Single-column agenda/outline slide: red-bordered content frame inset within a white page; bold red title centered at top; yellow oval slide-number badge at top-right inside the frame; six left-aligned blue text lines stacked in the upper-left/middle area; large empty area in lower half; solid black bar along the bottom edge of the slide

regions.name: Title
regions.position: top, horizontally centered, roughly 8%-20% vertical, 24%-66% horizontal

regions.name: Slide number badge
regions.content: Yellow oval with dark outline containing the number 6

regions.name: Agenda list
regions.content: Six blue bold text lines (topic list), no bullet glyphs

regions.name: Empty lower area
regions.position: bottom, approx 70%-95% vertical, full width inside red frame

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (largest, red, bold); agenda lines are medium-sized bold blue and visually secondary; slide-number badge is small; the black bottom bar is a low-prominence decorative strip; large whitespace gives the slide an airy outline feel

visual_elements.description: Thin red rectangular border framing the entire content area of the slide, inset from the slide edges (roughly 5% margin left/right/top, extending down to just above the black bottom bar)
Slide-number badge: small yellow filled oval/ellipse with a thin dark blue/purple outline containing the numeral '6' in dark text
visual_elements.position: top-right corner inside the red frame

visual_elements.description: Solid black horizontal bar along the bottom edge of the slide, spanning nearly the full width (small white gaps at extreme left and right corners)

Mouse cursor (white arrow with dark outline) captured mid-slide, positioned just below and left of the words 'as a' on the 'Transformer Encoder  as a Classifier' line — an artifact of the recorded lecture, not slide content

imagery: No photos, icons, or illustrations; only the mouse-cursor arrow overlay from the screen recording
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial-like). Title is bold, noticeably larger than body, red. Agenda lines are bold, medium size, blue, left-aligned with no bullet characters or numbering; spacing between lines is generous and roughly even. Some lines contain double spaces (e.g., 'Parallelization  Implementation Issues', 'Transformer Encoder  as a Classifier'). 'What is Next ?' has a space before the question mark. Slide number is small dark text in the badge. No italics or all-caps styling.
animation_state: All six agenda lines are fully visible (no mid-build reveal). A mouse cursor is frozen over the fifth line, indicating a live-recorded lecture rather than an animation state.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with an off-white background (#F2F2F2). 2. Draw a thin red (#C00000) rectangle outline inset ~5% from left/right/top and ending just above the bottom edge to frame the content. 3. Add a solid black rectangle strip across the bottom edge, ~4% tall, spanning ~4%-96% of the width. 4. Center a text box near the top (vertical ~8%-20%) with the text 'Transformers – Part II' in bold red (#C00000) sans-serif (Arial), ~40pt. 5. In the top-right corner inside the frame, draw a small yellow (#FFFF99) oval with a thin dark-blue (#333399) outline containing the number '6' in dark bold text. 6. Add a left-aligned text block starting ~12% from the left, ~26% from the top, with six lines in bold blue (#1414B8) sans-serif ~20-22pt, no bullet glyphs, generous line spacing: 'Parallelization  Implementation Issues' / 'Positional Information' / 'Building Transformer Block' / 'Transformer Decoder' / 'Transformer Encoder  as a Classifier' / 'What is Next ?' — preserve the double spaces and the space before the question mark exactly. 7. Leave the lower ~30% of the framed area empty. 8. Optionally overlay a white arrow mouse-cursor image below the words 'as a' on line five to match the captured frame (or omit if a clean slide is desired).
